dialog.about_body:
Fast, private and free PDF workspace
Stability, Shortcuts & Adaptive Performance 7.3.1
Local processing • No cloud • Community open source
dialog.about_license: Open source under GPL-3.0-or-later. The MaenPDF name and logo follow the project brand policy.
dialog.ocr_local_note: OCR runs locally on this device. It requires the optional OCR engine and local PDF tools; no document is uploaded.
dialog.password_required: This PDF requires a password. Enter it to continue.
dialog.recovery_choice: Recover it before starting new work, or discard the recovery snapshot.
dialog.recovery_found: MaenPDF found an autosaved document from an earlier session.
dialog.search_note: Search indexes original PDF text. Overlay text is not structural content yet.
dialog.unsaved_all: One or more tabs have unsaved changes. Save the documents you need before closing, or discard all changes and exit.
dialog.unsaved_tab: This tab has unsaved changes. Save, discard, or cancel closing it.
error.cannot_write: Cannot write PDF to this location.
error.choose_save_as: Choose Save As for a new document.
error.content_read: Unable to read the selected document from Android storage.
error.content_write: Unable to write the selected document to Android storage.
error.open_pdf: Unable to open PDF. It may be encrypted, damaged, or unsupported.
error.password_required: An open password is required for protected export.
error.safe_replace: Could not safely replace the existing PDF. It may be open in another program.
error.save_restored: Save failed; the original PDF was restored.
error.save_verification: Save verification failed; the original file was left unchanged.
error.secure_temp: Unable to create a secure temporary file.
error.security_create: Security provider could not create the protected PDF.
error.security_provider_missing: Encrypted PDF export requires the qpdf security provider on desktop. Android release builds need a mobile-compatible security provider.
error.security_timeout: Protected export timed out and was cancelled.
error.unsupported_security: This PDF uses a security scheme that the local reader cannot unlock.
home.privacy_body: Your documents are processed locally. No MaenPDF cloud account is required.
home.subtitle: Fast, private, bilingual PDF tools for everyday work — built to stay useful on older and newer devices.
home.title: MaenPDF 7.3.1
info.recovered: Recovered autosaved document. Use Save As to keep it.
info.redaction_added: Redaction area added. Saving creates a flattened PDF so covered content is not preserved underneath.
info.text_copied: Selected text copied to the clipboard.
preferences.safe_graphics_note: Use software graphics only if your GPU/driver is unstable. Restart MaenPDF after changing this option.
preferences.shortcuts_note: Single-key tool shortcuts: V Select, H Hand, T Text, U Highlight, D Draw, C Crop, Shift+Y Redact.
print.done: Print job sent to the system printer.
print.error.no_document: There is no document to print.
print.error.unavailable: System printing is not available on this platform yet.
privacy.body: MaenPDF is designed for local PDF processing. Documents are not uploaded to MaenPDF servers, and core use does not require an account, subscription, or cloud storage. External links open only when you choose them.
privacy.heading: Your documents stay on your device
properties.name: Name
provider.optional_note: Optional engines are used only when installed. MaenPDF remains usable without them and does not upload documents to replace missing local tools.
security.explanation: Protected export uses standard PDF encryption, so compatible PDF readers can recognize and open the file with its password.
shortcuts.note: MaenPDF follows familiar Acrobat-style shortcuts where practical, while keeping standard Windows shortcuts. Single-key tool shortcuts can be disabled in Preferences.
status.ui_responsive: The job runs in the background so the interface stays responsive.
status.wait_operation: Please wait for the current local operation to finish before closing MaenPDF.
support.not_configured: The official donation link has not been configured yet. The maintainer can add it without changing core PDF features.
tool.crop_hint: Drag the crop area, adjust the corner handles, then press Apply.
tool.crop_ready: Crop area ready — adjust the handles or press Apply.
tool.draw_hint: Draw directly on the page. Your stroke is previewed live.
tool.hand_hint: Drag the page to pan. Use the mouse wheel to scroll, or Ctrl+wheel to zoom.
tool.highlight_hint: Drag across real PDF text to highlight it.
tool.pointer_hint: Drag across PDF text to select it. Use the mouse wheel to move between pages.
tool.redact_hint: Drag a region, review it, then press Apply.
tool.redact_ready: Redaction area ready — press Apply to commit it.
tool.selection_ready: Text selected — copy it or convert it to a highlight.
tool.text_hint: Click anywhere on the page to add text.
tools.done.ocr: Created searchable OCR PDF from %1 page(s).
tools.error.check_failed: The PDF check reported a problem.
tools.error.image_read: The image could not be read.
tools.error.image_write: The image output could not be written.
tools.error.input_missing: The input file does not exist.
tools.error.invalid_pdf: The selected file is not a readable PDF.
tools.error.libreoffice_missing: The optional local office conversion engine is not installed.
tools.error.merge: OCR pages could not be merged into the final PDF.
tools.error.ocr_language: The OCR language code is invalid.
tools.error.password: The PDF password is missing or incorrect.
tools.error.password_or_process: The password may be incorrect, or the local tool could not complete the operation.
tools.error.path: The selected input or output path is not usable.
tools.error.process: The local tool could not complete the operation.
tools.error.qpdf_missing: The optional local PDF tools engine is not installed.
tools.error.security_scheme: The PDF security scheme is unsupported.
tools.error.temp: A secure temporary workspace could not be created.
tools.error.tesseract_missing: The optional local OCR engine is not installed.
tools.error.write_pdf: The output PDF could not be written.
